record.summary: Apart from the accepted deviations (bottom tab bar, two card columns, shorter tiles, the Pinned pill and full purpose text), the render matches the reference: the header, the New project button, the menu buttons, the card gaps and the title-to-purpose spacing measure the same.

accepted_deviations.as_given: New project shows as the frame draws it and does nothing: making a project is increment four, as it needs a back-end script for the brain and the folders (d-133, f-008 increment one, Out of scope).
accepted_deviations.note: The button looks the same as in the reference, at the top right, 988-1101 x 24-60. A still picture cannot show what it does.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Edit details shows in each card's menu and does nothing: editing a project's details is increment four (d-133).
accepted_deviations.note: All card menus are closed in both pictures.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Pin icon. The library has no pin icon, so a pinned card shows the 16 px pill "Pinned" after its name, which keeps the name's line height, so its name and purpose sit level with the other cards' (LIBRARY_GAPS.md, Pin icon).
accepted_deviations.note: The NCC-1701 card shows a small "Pinned" pill after its name. Its name and purpose sit at the same height as those on the Pinpoint card.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Tile. The letter tile is shorter than the frame's and its letter is the heading style, smaller than the frame's; no token has the frame's height or letter size (LIBRARY_GAPS.md, Project tile).
accepted_deviations.note: The tile is about 120 px tall in the render and about 200 px in the reference. The letter is smaller. The menu button keeps its size and place.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Purpose. The purpose is a bodySm paragraph in the card's meta row, as the library's Card description shows only one or two lines (LIBRARY_GAPS.md, Card description).

Purpose wraps. The purpose is bodySm (13/20), whose glyphs are about 4 % narrower than the frame's (LIBRARY_GAPS.md, Purpose text style); with the tablet layout's two wider columns the lines break at other words than the frame's in any case.
accepted_deviations.note: The lines break at different words in the wider cards. No text is cut.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Unpin. A pinned card's menu says Unpin in place of Pin to top. No frame draws a pinned card's menu.

Owner's name. NCC-1701's purpose starts "The owner's personal workspace" in the state file, where the frame has the owner's name: the secret scan's personal-term rule keeps the name out of web/. The live home shows the brain's own words.
accepted_deviations.note: The render shows "The owner's personal workspace for thinking, ...".

accepted_deviations.as_given: Cards heading. A heading "All projects" that only a screen reader reads sits between the page title and the cards, so the heading levels go 1, 2, 3 (the stories' accessibility check). No frame draws it.
accepted_deviations.note: No visible heading appears in the render, which is what the deviation says.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Layout. At 1133 px the iPad in landscape is narrower than the desktop layout's 1232 (lib/viewport.ts), so it draws the tablet layout, as Settings T3 does: the tab bar in place of the frame's rail, and two columns of cards in place of the frame's three (LIBRARY_GAPS.md, Card grid columns). The tab bar is the shared one in the default order: Home, Inbox, Workspaces, Projects, Artifacts and More.
accepted_deviations.note: There is no left rail. The bottom tab bar shows Home, Inbox (badge 9), Workspaces, Projects (selected), Artifacts and More. The cards are in two columns, and omni is in a second row. The page content starts at x=32, and the gaps between cards are 21 px, as in the reference.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Purpose. Each purpose shows whole; the frame cuts it at three lines (LIBRARY_GAPS.md, Card description).
accepted_deviations.note: Each purpose shows in full on two lines.

limits: The scattered background stars are decorative, so I did not compare them one by one.
